capabilities: Check or uncheck parent checkboxes based on children's state
Cascade parent checkbox changes to child checkboxes
Configure upward and downward sync directions
Define which checkbox symbols count as checked, unchecked, or ignored
Exclude files from syncing with ignore rules
extras: Detailed documentation (English and Russian) is hosted externally; the README itself lists features and links to installation, settings, and usage guides.
problem: Obsidian task lists leave nested checkboxes independent, so a parent can stay unchecked even when all its subtasks are completed.
summary: Checkbox state sync for nested lists that checks parents when all children are done and can cascade parent changes down to children.
